## 🚨 EasyTrade – High-Risk Service Leaderboard
Composite **0–100** risk per service: errors 0.25 · latency 0.20 · saturation 0.20 · change recency 0.15 · Davis 0.20, × blast-radius multiplier (1–1.5). Baseline = 24h→2h ago, current = last 2h. 🔴 Broken · 🟠 Deteriorating · 🟡 Watch · 🟢 Recovering · ⚪ Stable. The leaderboard auto-detects the active cluster; the other tiles are pinned to `{{ .clusterUid }}`.

1.title: Ingest lag (s)
1.query: fetch spans, from: now()-15m | filter k8s.namespace.name == "easytrade" | summarize last = max(start_time) | fieldsAdd lagSeconds = toLong((now() - last) / 1s) | fields lagSeconds

2.title: Active Davis problems
2.query: fetch dt.davis.problems, from: now()-24h | sort timestamp desc | dedup event.id | filter event.status == "ACTIVE" | summarize activeProblems = count()

3.title: Failed requests, last 2h (%)
3.query: timeseries {fail = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, scalar:true), req = sum(dt.service.request.count, scalar:true)}, filter: k8s.cluster.uid == "{{ .clusterUid }}", from: now()-2h | fieldsAdd failPct = 100 * fail / req | fields failPct

4.title: Ingress p95, last 2h (ms)
4.query: timeseries p95 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 95, scalar:true), filter: k8s.cluster.uid == "{{ .clusterUid }}" and k8s.workload.name == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy", from: now()-2h | fieldsAdd p95ms = p95 / 1000 | fields p95ms

6.title: p95 latency by service, 12h (ms)
6.query: timeseries p95 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 95), by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.uid == "{{ .clusterUid }}", interval: 15m, from: now()-12h | fieldsAdd p95ms = p95[] / 1000 | fields timeframe, interval, k8s.workload.name, p95ms

7.title: Failure rate by service, 12h (%)
7.query: timeseries {req = sum(dt.service.request.count), fail = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count)}, by:{k8s.workload.name}, filter: k8s.cluster.uid == "{{ .clusterUid }}", interval: 15m, from: now()-12h | fieldsAdd failPct = 100 * fail[] / req[] | fields timeframe, interval, k8s.workload.name, failPct

8.title: Failures by endpoint, 12h
8.query: fetch spans, from: now()-12h | filter k8s.cluster.uid == "{{ .clusterUid }}" and span.kind == "server" and request.is_failed == true | summarize {failures = count(), last = max(start_time)}, by:{k8s.workload.name, span.name, http.response.status_code} | sort failures desc | limit 25

9.title: Log errors: baseline vs last 2h
9.query: fetch logs, from: now()-12h | filter k8s.namespace.name == "easytrade" and k8s.cluster.uid == "{{ .clusterUid }}" and in(loglevel, array("ERROR", "SEVERE", "FATAL")) | fieldsAdd period = if(timestamp < now()-2h, "baseline", else: "last 2h") | summarize {errors = count(), sample = takeFirst(substring(content, to: 160))}, by:{k8s.workload.name, period} | sort k8s.workload.name asc

10.title: Davis problems, 12h
10.query: fetch dt.davis.problems, from: now()-12h | sort timestamp desc | dedup event.id | fields display_id, event.name, event.status, event.start, event.end, affected_entity_ids, root_cause_entity_id | sort event.start desc
